verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents first-party APIs for driving core workflows without the UI: an Alerts API that ingests monitoring alerts into cases, a Case API for creating and updating cases, list/fetch endpoints for syncing, batch case import, and filing validation and status monitoring, authenticated with org-level API keys. That gives real programmatic, headless use of the product, but nothing shows a CLI, CI integration, or a non-interactive runner, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: official CLI or CI/pipeline integration docs, published OpenAPI/API reference, documented service-account/non-interactive auth flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of automated headless use.
